closed_taxonomy.gate-strength: The clause carries decision weight the trader acts on before entry — a hard requirement, a soft/bonus confluence the trader adds, or an either/or route. If a reasonable trader would change their entry decision based on this clause, it has gate-strength.

closed_taxonomy.cannot-determine: The quote carries no clear modal gate signal either way; the surrounding evidence is insufficient to call gate-strength vs context.

items.extracted_condition_text: Identify the 4H candle opening at 10:00 AM, as this is the highest win rate candle for the strategy.
The speaker specifies the 10:00 AM 4H candle as the optimal time for this setup.
Look for a market structure shift (MSS) relative to the opening price of the 4H candle.
The MSS determines the directional bias (long or short) for the trade.
Measure the manipulation phase by projecting Fibonacci/Standard Deviation levels (e.g., -2, -2.5) from the last swing low to the last swing high before the MSS.
This measurement defines the manipulation phase and the target area for the expansion.
Wait for SMT divergence (e.g., NQ makes a higher high, but ES fails to do so) around the projected manipulation phase levels.
SMT divergence confirms that the manipulation phase is over and the expansion is imminent.
A sweep of liquidity confirms the exhaustion of the opposing side and signals entry.
The market must show a market structure shift relative to the 4H candle opening price.
SMT divergence must be present around the projected manipulation phase levels.
Price must sweep and close below consecutive candles that swept a significant liquidity level.
The strategy is specifically applied to the 10:00 a.m. 4-hour candle.
The stop must be placed beyond the structural invalidation point (the high/low of the entry candle).
Target the projected liquidity level (e.g., -2.5) which aligns with the measured manipulation phase.
